title: Roll out the hardened gateway dev, qa, prod and prove destructive calls are refused
description: Build the mcp-gateway image from the main commit that contains tasks 1-3. Deploy it one environment at a time following sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess.environmentsOrder (dev via docker compose, then qa, then prod on EKS ap-south-1), with releaseProcess.approvalsRequired 1 for each environment. Before each rollout, record the current image digest as the rollback target. policy.json defines no deploymentWindows and applications/mcp-gateway/env/qa.json and prod.json set no changeFreeze, so agree the prod slot with the CAB. Complete prod by Monday 2026-09-21 12:00 UTC, before the findings' slaDueAt of 2026-09-21T19:14:04Z. In dev and qa, use an MCP client that does not declare the elicitation capability (for example an MCP SDK Client created with empty capabilities). Call tools/list, then call drop-collection on a scratch collection maxwell_cm_canary in a throwaway database created for the test, never a client-data or order database. In prod, run only the non-destructive tools/list check against the gateway endpoint, because prod holds pii and financial data. If any check fails, follow the initiative rollback plan.
acceptanceCriteria: In dev and qa, drop-collection called from a client without elicitation capability returns an error result and a following list-collections still shows maxwell_cm_canary
In dev, qa and prod, tools/list from the gateway shows no create, update or delete tool beyond the allow-list recorded in task 3
The prod deployment runs the image digest built from the merged commit, and the previous digest is recorded as the rollback target in the task evidence
Prod rollout finishes before 2026-09-21T19:14:04Z and the scratch database is dropped from qa after the test

verificationMethod.description: probe-agent-graph is a static probe and cannot observe the deployed gateway, so this is a manual test. With an MCP client whose capabilities omit elicitation: in qa, tools/list must show no unapproved write tool, and drop-collection on the scratch collection maxwell_cm_canary must return an error while the collection still exists afterwards. In prod, tools/list must match the approved allow-list. Attach the client transcripts and the before/after image digests as task evidence.

rootCause.description: The deployed qa and prod gateways run a build that has no fail-closed confirmation and no write allow-list, so fixing the code does not reduce risk until the hardened image reaches those environments.
